import hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
from snail import match as m
ROOT=Path('/Users/banteg/dev/banteg/snail-mail')
OUT=Path('/private/tmp/snail-house-20260912')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def fullname(name):return 'initialize_'+name+'_path_template_pair'
def source(name):return (ROOT/'tools/match/scratches'/fullname(name)/'scratch.cpp').read_text()
def function(s,name):
 hit=re.search(r'static __forceinline\s+[^{}]*?\b'+re.escape(name)+r'\s*\([^{}]*\)\s*\{',s)
 assert hit,name
 pos=hit.end();depth=1
 while depth:depth+=(s[pos]=='{')-(s[pos]=='}');pos+=1
 return s[hit.start():pos]
def replace_once(s,a,b):
 assert s.count(a)==1,(s.count(a),a[:100]);return s.replace(a,b,1)
def run(name,variants,batch):
 config=m.load_scratch_config(ROOT/'tools/match/scratches'/fullname(name))
 directory=OUT/name/batch;directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 rows=[]
 for label,text in variants:
  (directory/(label+'.cpp')).write_text(text)
  matches=[]
  status=m.evaluate_source_overlay(config,text,on_match=matches.append)
  row={'label':label,'source':text,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),'status':m.scratch_status_payload(status)}
  if matches:row.update(diagnostics=m.match_result_payload(matches[0]),diff=matches[0].diff_lines)
  rows.append(row);(directory/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(name,label,round(status.ratio*100,8),f'{status.candidate_instructions}/{status.target_instructions}','prefix',status.prefix_instructions,'exact',status.body_byte_exact,'refs',status.masked_ok,status.masked_unresolved,status.masked_mismatches,status.masked_unaudited,'error',status.error,flush=True)
 return rows

from snail_humpdump_probe import *

import tempfile

def capture(name,text):
 config=m.load_scratch_config(ROOT/'tools/match/scratches'/fullname(name))
 manifest=m.load_function_symbol_manifest(m.DEFAULT_FUNCTION_SYMBOL_MANIFEST_PATH)
 image_path=ROOT/manifest.primary_target
 start,end=m.resolve_function_extent(manifest,config.function,config.end_va)
 target=m.load_image(image_path,manifest.image_base).function_bytes(start,end)
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='snail-house-proof-',dir='/private/tmp') as tmp:
  path=Path(tmp);(path/'scratch.cpp').write_text(text);shadow=replace(config,directory=path)
  obj=m.compile_scratch(shadow);obj_bytes=obj.read_bytes()
  candidate=m.extract_object_function(m.parse_coff_object(obj_bytes),config.symbol or config.function,reference_manifest=m.load_default_reference_symbol_manifest())
  result=m.run_match(obj_path=obj,function_name=config.function,image_path=image_path,manifest=manifest,symbol_name=config.symbol,end_va=config.end_va)
  entries=result.masked_operand_audit.entries
  return {'source':text,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),'raw_candidate':candidate.data.hex(),'raw_target':target.hex(),'candidate_object_sha256':hashlib.sha256(obj_bytes).hexdigest(),'diagnostics':m.match_result_payload(result),'masked_operand_audit':asdict(result.masked_operand_audit),'target_instructions':[asdict(x) for x in result.target_disassembly],'candidate_instructions':[asdict(x) for x in result.candidate_disassembly],'positional_counts':{'references':len(entries),'same_index':sum(e.target_index==e.candidate_index for e in entries),'same_offset':sum(e.target_offset==e.candidate_offset for e in entries)},'diff':result.diff_lines}

if __name__=='__main__':
 from snail_encoded import encoded
 for name,control in [('hump','encoded-controls/logical-deltas.cpp'),('dump','physical-owners/departure-curve-index.cpp')]:
  s=(OUT/name/'cleanup/canonical-format.cpp').read_text();p=(OUT/name/control).read_text()
  retained=capture(name,s);previous=capture(name,p)
  assert retained['raw_candidate']==previous['raw_candidate']
  print(name,'cleanup raw body preserved',retained['positional_counts'],flush=True)
  payload={'baseline':capture(name,source(name)),'retained':retained}

   assert audit['diagnostics']['body_byte_exact']
